name: Sven's Revenge
summary: In southern Duskwood, grief sends Sven Yorgen from his ruined farm in pursuit of its killers. Now camped in the western hills, he asks travelers to return to the farmstead where a stranger buried something near the barn.

sections.title: Tragedy at the Farmstead
sections.body: Hooded Dark Riders came down from Deadwind Pass and attacked Sven Yorgen's farm in southeastern Duskwood. While Sven was away, they killed his family. Returning to the slaughter, Sven saw an unknown figure skulking near the barn, hurriedly burying something. He left the hidden object behind and set out to hunt the killers.

sections.title: Unearthing Secrets
sections.body: Sven Yorgen is camped in the western hills, consumed by wrath and seeking help at his farmstead. Between the farmhouse and ruined barn, behind an old tree stump, a mound of loose dirt marks where something was hastily buried. Recovering it may help explain why the shadowy riders targeted a quiet Duskwood farmer.

faq.answer: Sven Yorgen was a farmer in southeastern Duskwood, near the border of Deadwind Pass. After hooded riders murdered his family, he left his farm and became a recluse bent on vengeance.
Dark Riders from Deadwind Pass attacked Sven Yorgen's farmstead and killed his family. The property was left in ruins while Sven was away.

faq.q: Who buried something behind the barn?
faq.answer: After the massacre, Sven saw a shadowy figure burying something near his barn. He pursued the Dark Riders before he could catch the stranger or uncover what was buried.

faq.q: Where is the mound of loose dirt located?
faq.answer: At the Yorgen Farmstead in southeastern Duskwood, a mound of loose dirt lies behind an old tree stump between the barn and ruined farmhouse.
The Dark Riders are hooded horsemen who ride out of Deadwind Pass. Their origins are unknown, but their attacks in Duskwood bring death and ruin.

faq.q: Why didn't Sven dig up the buried item himself?
aliases: why didn't sven check the dirt
faq.answer: Sven was overcome with grief when he returned home and saw a figure burying something. He immediately pursued the retreating Dark Riders, leaving the object behind.

angles.text: The slaughter of the Yorgen family shows how far dark forces reach in isolated Duskwood, where Stormwind army patrols are scarce.
As a paladin, you see the slaughter of innocents by forces from Deadwind Pass as a call for justice for the dead.
